tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Is an address or lat/lng inside a RentADriver service area? covered=true means a delivery can be booked there (in a book-ahead city, RentADriver matches a driver for the scheduled time). Free, no API key.

tools.name: list_service_areas
tools.description: Cities with currency, timezone, radius and tier. tier is driver presence, not whether booking works: "live" = drivers based there were online in the last 24 h; "scheduled" = bookable, approved drivers are based there (book ahead, we match one); "waitlist" = not bookable yet. Never call a scheduled c

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price and conditional ETA for a pickup and one or more drop-offs. Null ETA means driver availability is unconfirmed; never promise a pickup time. Free, no key. Returns a quote_id valid 15 minutes; pass it to create_delivery. The quote card shows these details: reply in one short line instead of repe

tools.name: list_intercity_lanes
tools.description: Same-day city-to-city routes: for every launch city, the neighbouring launch cities within 160 km by road (e.g. London → Reading, Leeds → Sheffield, San Francisco → San Jose) with road distance, drive time and a same-day sample price. Longer trips are not offered. Free.

tools.name: get_intercity_quote
tools.description: Price a same-day delivery to a neighbouring city: pickup in a launch city, drop-off in (or within 20 km of) another launch city in the same country at most 160 km away by road. One dedicated driver collects within about an hour; it must arrive by 21:00 local time, otherwise pickup moves to the next

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Live counts: service areas, deliveries, agents connected.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search RentADriver's published documentation (API, MCP tools, pricing, coverage, integrations, answers, FAQ). Returns titles, absolute URLs to cite and a snippet; read a page with read_docs_page.

tools.name: read_docs_page
tools.description: Full text of one documentation page, by a URL from search_docs or list_docs_sections.

tools.name: list_docs_sections
tools.description: Every documentation section with its pages (title and URL).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Published pricing: pay per delivery, no subscription, starting prices by city and the pricing page URL. Use get_quote for the exact price of a route.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Published FAQ answers (agents, businesses and drivers), optionally filtered by a topic such as "payment" or "proof of delivery".

tools.name: list_country_workspaces
tools.description: List enabled country workspaces, their separate local-currency balances, and available countries. No FX or balance transfers.

tools.name: enable_country_workspace
tools.description: Enable another delivery country in this account. Admin role required. Starts with zero local-currency balance; existing money stays untouched. Set spending controls independently for this workspace.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Self-serve signup for an agent/app. Returns an API key ONCE. Save it as RENTADRIVER_API_KEY. Rehearse with a sandbox (rd_test_) key; live bookings need a funded wallet.

tools.name: check_account_status
tools.description: Confirms the API key works; returns balance, caps and capabilities.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Selected country balance and ledger. Omit workspace_id for the original default wallet.

tools.name: create_wallet_deposit
tools.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout URL a human must open to pay. Wallet is credited on payment.

tools.name: create_x402_deposit
tools.description: Agent-native funding: returns x402 v2 payment requirements (USDC on Base). Sign with an x402 client and re-call with the X-Payment header via the REST endpoint.

tools.name: set_spending_controls
tools.description: Cap per-delivery and rolling 24-hour spend in workspace currency minor units. Zero blocks, null clears. Defaults to original workspace.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: Lists the account's API keys with prefix, name, last use and revocation state. Full keys are never returned.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Issues an additional key (up to 50 active; sign-in sessions do not count) for another agent or environment. The key is shown once.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Permanently deactivates a key. You cannot revoke the key you are calling with.

tools.name: create_delivery
tools.description: Books a delivery. Pass quote_id from get_quote, or pickup+dropoffs directly. fund=true (default) holds the price from your wallet and starts dispatch. Use dryRun=true first to see the price without committing. Returns next_action. The delivery card shows these details: reply in one short line instea

tools.name: create_store_pickup
tools.description: Shortcut for the most common agent job: collect a prepaid order from a store and deliver it. Pickup contact gets the order reference in the instructions. The delivery card shows these details: reply in one short line instead of repeating them.

tools.name: create_batch
tools.description: Up to 25 create_delivery payloads in one call.

tools.name: fund_delivery
tools.description: For deliveries created with fund=false, or after topping up the wallet. The delivery card shows these details: reply in one short line instead of repeating them.

tools.name: get_delivery
tools.description: Full delivery by id or short code (RD-XXXXXXX). Hosts that support MCP Apps render a live tracker card. The delivery card shows these details: reply in one short line instead of repeating them.

tools.name: list_deliveries
tools.description: status='active' or a comma list; since ISO datetime.

tools.name: create_recipient_code
tools.description: Generate or replace a six-digit code for a delivery stop requiring OTP proof. Share it privately with the intended recipient, never the driver. Replacing invalidates the old code. Expires in seven days; five failed attempts lock it.

tools.name: track_delivery
tools.description: Live status, ETA, driver position and last event. Poll this every 30–60s while active. The delivery card shows these details: reply in one short line instead of repeating them.

tools.name: get_delivery_events
tools.description: Every event on the delivery in order: created, funded, dispatching, offers, assigned, each driver step, delivered, confirmed, paid, plus messages.

tools.name: update_delivery
tools.description: Change instructions, contingency rules or the drop-off contact while in progress.

tools.name: cancel_delivery
tools.description: Free before a driver is assigned; a cancellation fee after assignment; not possible after pickup.

tools.name: create_return
tools.description: Create the reverse delivery (last drop-off back to pickup).

tools.name: send_message_to_driver
tools.description: Delivered as a push + in-app message once a driver is assigned.

tools.name: get_delivery_messages
tools.description: The full message thread between you and the driver for one delivery, oldest first.

tools.name: get_proof_of_delivery
tools.description: Signed photo URLs (1h), signature, recipient name, geo + time.

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: Releases payment to the driver. Auto-confirms 24h after delivery if you don't.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Funds stay held; ops reviews within 24h.

tools.name: tip_driver
tools.description: Cents, from your wallet. Reuse idempotency_key when retrying the same tip.

tools.name: rate_driver
tools.description: Rate the driver of a completed delivery from 1 to 5 stars, with an optional comment.

tools.name: list_shopify_orders
tools.description: Orders the RentADriver app for Shopify has seen on the shops connected to this account, with the booking status (booked / skipped / needs_funds / failed) and the linked delivery. Requires the app to be installed on the store: https://rentadriver.ai/integrations/shopify

tools.name: book_shopify_order
tools.description: Book a same-day delivery for a Shopify order by its name (e.g. #1042) or id. Pickup is the store location, drop-off the order's shipping address, items from the line items. Fetches the order from Shopify if the app has not seen it. force=true ignores the shop's radius and size limits. On success the

tools.name: list_store_orders
tools.description: Orders the RentADriver connector has seen on the WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix Stores or Squarespace stores connected to this account, with the booking status (booked / skipped / needs_funds / failed) and the linked delivery. Requires the store to be connected: https://rentadriver.ai/integrations/<p

tools.name: book_store_order
tools.description: Book a same-day delivery for a WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix Stores or Squarespace order by its number (e.g. #1042) or id. Pickup is the store location, drop-off the order's shipping address, items from the line items. Fetches the order from the platform if the connector has not seen it. force=true

tools.name: register_webhook
tools.description: HMAC-signed POSTs for delivery.* events. Returns the signing secret once.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Active webhooks registered on the account.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Deactivates a webhook; queued deliveries to it stop.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, read_docs_page, list_docs_sections, get_pricing, create_wallet_deposit, get_delivery_events, get_delivery_messages, get_proof_of_delivery, open_dispute · Private data: check_coverage, signup, check_account_status, get_wallet_balance, create_wallet_deposit, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, create_delivery, create_store_pickup, fund_delivery, update_delivery, tip_driver, register_webhook · Public sink: create_recipient_code, send_message_to_driver, register_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: get_quote, get_intercity_quote, update_delivery, create_return, book_shopify_order, book_store_order, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, read_docs_page, list_docs_sections, get_pricing, create_wallet_deposit, get_delivery_events, get_delivery_messages, get_proof_of_delivery, open_dispute · Private data: check_coverage, signup, check_account_status, get_wallet_balance, create_wallet_deposit, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, create_delivery, create_store_pickup, fund_delivery, update_delivery, tip_driver, register_webhook · Public sink: create_recipient_code, send_message_to_driver, register_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: get_quote, get_intercity_quote, update_delivery, create_return, book_shopify_order, book_store_order, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
